decisions.reason: Custom earmolds for in-ear systems build directly on the firm’s existing hearing-system materials and in-house laboratory knowledge, giving high absorptive capacity to interpret early results and refine the product.
The branded Dreve EARsleeve leverages the firm’s core earmold and digital production capabilities, enabling strong absorptive capacity and confident learning from market feedback.

The vacuum thermoforming unit is adjacent to the firm’s dental equipment and lab workflow knowledge but requires more mechanical engineering and service capabilities, so its drop probability is higher; still, keeping it allows the firm to deepen absorptive capacity in equipment.
